reasoning: Line 470-471 is verbatim as quoted. I traced d_ssa_phaseLen: the host counting pass sets 'h_ssa_phaseLen(workPhase) = workItem;' (:346) where workItem counts every bin triple in the phase, but the device build overwrites it with the COMPACTED count - build_locals_onePhase ends with 'if (firstTry) { d_ssa_phaseLen(workPhase) = workItem; ... }' (:652-653), and workItem there is incremented only inside 'if (inum > inum_start)' (:632-636). So a phase in which no atom acquired a neighbor yields phaseLen == 0 and the expression indexes column -1 of h_ssa_itemLoc/h_ssa_itemLen. The most obvious trigger is an MPI rank with no local atoms (every work item empty in every phase). The CPU builder has no such construct: src/DPD-REACT/npair_half_bin_newton_ssa.cpp:112 'int inum = 0;' accumulated through the loops and :244 'list->inum = inum;'. Two notes: (a) the last work phase is the zoff=yoff=xoff=0 one (the phase table is filled in descending offset order, :154-160), so it is the phase most likely to be non-empty - the trigger is emptiness of the atoms, not of the bin range; (b) the identical pattern for gnum at :484-485 ('h_ssa_gitemLoc(ssa_gphaseCt-1,h_ssa_gphaseLen(ssa_gphaseCt-1)-1)') has the same hole and must be fixed together. For ssa_phaseCt > 1 the -1 index lands on the previous row's last element (garbage inum rather than a segfault); for ssa_phaseCt == 1 it reads before the allocation.
fix: Guard both totals, e.g. 'const int pl = h_ssa_phaseLen(ssa_phaseCt-1); data.neigh_list.inum = pl ? (h_ssa_itemLoc(ssa_phaseCt-1,pl-1) + h_ssa_itemLen(ssa_phaseCt-1,pl-1)) : 0;' and the analogous guard for gnum at :484-485.
